title: Gimbal UFO video argument between Marik von Rennenkampff and Mick West

tellings.quote: been having this argument around the gimbal UFO video with a a gentleman named Mick W

plain: The Gimbal video, a 2015 US Navy clip of an unidentified object filmed from a fighter jet, is the subject of a running argument between a man named Marik von Rennenkampff and another man named Mick West. The journalist Michael Shellenberger mentions it to Michels, saying von Rennenkampff has been having this argument about the video with West. He brings it up in passing, as an example of how hard people still fight over what the footage shows.
